candidates.description: This feature vector activates on non-English script fragments, punctuation marks, and subword suffixes from various multilingual and programming contexts.
This vector represents fragments of Hindi text, particularly consisting of dependent vowel signs, consonants, and common word endings.
This vector is related to sub-word tokens and character combinations typical of the Devanagari script.
This vector represents Hindi pronouns, adjectives, and quantifier words related to quantity, selection, or distinction.
These tokens primarily represent fragments of Hindi text written in the Devanagari script, alongside minor artifacts and encoding noise.
This feature vector represents common Hindi vowel sign combinations and diphthongs used in character-level text representation.
This vector activates strongly on the Hindi letter 'अ' and its various conjuncts, vowels, and phonetic variations.
This vector activates on various forms of the Hindi vowel 'i' (इ/ई) and its associated dependent vowel sign (matra ⁠ि) across different scripts and encodings.
This feature vector represents first- and second-person pronouns, primarily in Hindi and Greek script fragments.
This vector represents common Hindi conjunct consonants formed with the anusvara (dot nasal) diacritic.
